Title: **American Feudalism**

FADE IN:

EXT. AMERICAN SUBURB - DAY

The sun beats down on a picturesque suburban neighborhood. MANICURED LAWNS stretch out before us, but closer inspection reveals signs of wear: fences topped with barbed wire, the houses marked with family crests.

Cut to:

EXT. MANOR HOUSE - DAY

A grand, modern manor, with SUVs parked outside. The LIEGE LORD (50s, stern) emerges, wearing a sharp suit adorned with a golden chain of office.

CUT TO:

INT. MANOR HOUSE - DAY

A grand room where TENANTS (various ages) in contemporary casual attire kneel, paying homage with smartphones in lieu of swords, displaying their digital tribute.

LIEGE LORD
(booming)
Your digital rent is due, peasants.

TENANT #1
(pleading)
My crops—my tweets—failed this season, my lord.

LIEGE LORD
Then you shall work harder on your viral content.

Cut to:

EXT. SUBURBAN STREET - DAY

A YOUNG COMMONER (20s) eyes the scene, secretly recording on a hidden camera.

YOUNG COMMONER
(to camera, a whisper)
This is feudal America. But the seeds of a digital revolution are sown.

FADE OUT.

Title: **Neon Nobility**

INT. VASSAL'S APARTMENT - DAY

A small, cluttered apartment, the walls lined with LED screens flashing news. The main character, JAMES, 30s, a serf in the service of his feudal lord, checks his phone for the latest orders.

CUT TO:

EXT. LORD'S MANSION - DAY

The lord's colossal mansion, a mix of futuristic architecture and medieval decor. Serfs, in 2010s attire, bow and hustle, serving their master, LORD VIKTOR, 50s, dressed in designer clothes and a gold chain signifying his rank.

CUT TO:

EXT. MARKET STREET - DAY

James walks through crowded streets, digital billboards advertise the latest gadgets. A group of KNIGHTS, clad in armor and carrying smartphones, patrol the area.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James meets his friend, LUCY, 20s, also a serf. They sit at a table, nervously discussing their lives.

JAMES
We're trapped, Lucy. Every day, the same servitude.

LUCY
(smiling)
We have our dreams, our music, our memes.

Suddenly, their phones beep with a message from Lord Viktor.

LORD VIKTOR (V.O.)
Report to the castle. It's time for the annual Tribute.

James and Lucy exchange anxious glances, their modern lives intertwined with ancient feudal obligations.

FADE OUT.

Title: "Feudal America"

EXT. SKYLINE OF NEW YORK CITY - DAY

The iconic skyline of New York City, shimmering under the summer sun. But the flag atop the Empire State Building doesn't bear stars and stripes—it's adorned with the crest of the ruling House.

CUT TO:

EXT. THE DOMAIN OF HOUSE ROCKEFELLER - DAY

A sprawling estate, encircled by walls that are both modern and medieval. Security drones patrol the skies while armored guards in futuristic armor stand at the gates.

CUT TO:

INT. HOUSE ROCKEFELLER THRONE ROOM - DAY

ELDER ROCKEFELLER, stern-faced and powerful, sits on a throne made of steel and circuitry. Servants and nobles kneel before him.

ELDER ROCKEFELLER
(booming)
The land is fruitful, and our coffers swell. Let it be known that any who defy House Rockefeller will feel the full might of our domain.

PEASANT, a middle-aged woman, approaches hesitantly, bowing.

PEASANT
Your Grace, the people of the Lower Boroughs suffer from lack of medicine and clean water.

ELDER ROCKEFELLER considers, then dismisses her with a wave.

EXT. LOWER BOROUGHS - DAY

The boroughs are grimy, littered with modern, yet decaying tenements. The people, clad in faded 2010s fashion, live amidst the technology of the era, smartphones and smart homes repurposed for subsistence.

Suddenly, the sound of horse hooves—knights on horseback clad in armor, patrolling the streets with drones overhead. They enforce the rule of the nobility with an iron fist.

CUT TO:

EXT. DOMAIN OF HOUSE ROCKEFELLER - SUNSET

The setting sun casts a golden glow over the estate, a stark contrast to the life beyond the walls.

FADE OUT.

Title: **Feudal Futures**

**FADE IN:**

EXT. BROAD AVENUE - DAY

The bustling streets of New York City are lined with towering skyscrapers, their facades displaying the crests of powerful feudal lords. People wear stylish clothes, a mix of modern fashion with medieval flair.

CUT TO:

EXT. SERF'S VILLAGE - DAY

We see a group of people, serfs, working diligently in a field. The overseer, dressed in 2010s business casual attire with a medieval chain of office, checks his smartphone, tracking their productivity.

CUT TO:

INT. CASTLE - THRONE ROOM - DAY

The castle is a fusion of a modern office building and a medieval fortress. LORD HARKON, in his 30s, is adorned in sleek, armored robes. He addresses his advisors, who are seated on ergonomic chairs.

LORD HARKON
Our serfs' productivity has doubled since the last harvest festival. Our investments in solar panels and automated farming have proved fruitful.

ADVISOR
Aye, but the neighboring lord covets our lands and our technologies.

LORD HARKON
Then we must fortify our borders with the latest in drone surveillance. Let us ensure our serfs' loyalty with a grand festival and fair wages.

**FADE OUT.**

The scene sets up a society that has advanced technologically yet is governed by the rigid structures of feudalism.
